plan.notes: AAS in Administration of Justice Studies 'Course Sequence by Term' as published in the official 2026-2027 MCC pathway map (Academic Plan Code 3181), retrieved 2026-10-01. The map publishes two pacing variants (full-time Terms 1-4 and part-time Terms 1-10); this seed follows the full-time variant (the catalog's canonical sequence). Sequenced sum = 71 (15+21+16+19) using maximum printed credit values for range cells, per the range convention; the catalog prints Total Credits Required 61-65 and carries its own disclaimer that 'Course Sequence total credits may differ from the program information located on the MCCCD curriculum website due to program and system design.' Restricted Elective rows are seeded as choice slots (complete 12-13 credits from the Restricted Electives options listed on the pathway map). Students must earn a grade of C or better in all courses within the program.
